notes: Package names and versions as text. macOS lists application bundle paths only; Windows reads machine-wide uninstall registry entries.

commands.linux:
# Standalone example: Package names and versions as text. macOS lists application bundle paths only; Windows reads machine-wide uninstall registry entries.
if command -v dpkg-query >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dpkg-query -W '-f=${Package} ${Version}\n'
else
  rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME} %{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}\n'
fi
commands.darwin:
# Standalone example: Package names and versions as text. macOS lists application bundle paths only; Windows reads machine-wide uninstall registry entries.
find /Applications -maxdepth 2 -type d -name '*.app' -prune
